design.name: 精卫
design.brief: A small mythical bird (Jingwei of the Shan Hai Jing, daughter of the Flame Emperor, who carries pebbles to fill the sea): a crow-sized songbird with a patterned black-and-white head, a white beak and bright red feet, glossy black body plumage (the dark colour block) with crimson wings and ember-orange wing tips, and a round pebble glowing with ember fire held in its beak. Stubborn and fearless; shown diving with its wings swept back, dropping the glowing pebble. About 0.45 m long with a 0.9 m wingspan.
design.turnaround_pose: with both wings spread fully OUT TO THE SIDES, flat and horizontal like a cross, tail feathers fanned straight backwards, both legs hanging straight down below the body with the feet visible, head facing forward, the beak CLOSED and EMPTY: NO pebble, NO stone and nothing held in the beak; NO flames, sparks or motion lines
design.turnaround_digits: each foot has three forward toes and one back toe; the long wing feathers are clearly separated; wing tips are never cut off by the frame.
modeled: bird body, wings and fanned tail
beak closed and empty (the pebble is the separate part pet_jingwei_pebble)
effects: flames and ember trail around the pebble
falling fire pebbles and their explosions
design.revision: 2026-10-18 用户指出火石和喙熔在一起：鸟身重出四视图（喙空着），火石单独建模（SM_PetPart_JingweiPebble），挂 pebble 挂点
